name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,722

clue.text: Obscure fairy tale prince queen ignored?

indicators.note: something ignored is left out, so one letter is dropped from the word

blocks.note: in the fairy tale, a prince is turned into a frog
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A storybook prince has become forgotten because the queen paid him no attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obscure' is a verb here, as in to cloud or hide. Take the R out of FROG to get FOG.
explanation.definitionFit: To fog something is to blur it or hide it from view, the verb sense of obscure.

clue.text: Brave expert supporting fellow

indicators.note: in a down clue, what supports another piece sits beneath it in the column

blocks.note: F is the standard abbreviation for fellow
an ace is someone highly skilled

explanation.surface: A skilled specialist backs up a courageous colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brave' is a verb: to brave a storm. In a down answer the expert goes underneath the fellow, so F comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To face danger means to confront it boldly, the same verb sense as to brave it.

clue.text: Greet us excitedly with wave, perhaps

indicators.note: doing something excitedly means in an agitated, jumbled way, so the letters are stirred up

blocks.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone greets a group enthusiastically, waving a hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks a wave as one example of the answer rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: A wave of the hand is one example of a bodily movement used to communicate meaning.

clue.text: Mobile hospital crossing river in swamp

indicators.note: to cross something is to span it, so one piece stretches over and around another

blocks.note: MASH stands for Mobile Army Surgical Hospital
R is the usual abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A field hospital fording a river while stuck in boggy ground.
explanation.walkthrough: MASH is the army field unit made famous by the TV series M*A*S*H.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name low-lying wet ground that is waterlogged and soft underfoot.

clue.text: Spotted condition of male lessens ingesting pill at last

indicators.note: 'at last' points to the final position, so only the closing letter is kept
to ingest is to swallow, so one piece takes another inside it

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for male
to ease is to lessen
the final letter of pill

explanation.surface: A man's spotty rash gets better once he has swallowed the last of his tablets.
explanation.walkthrough: EASES swallows the L, and M goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Measles is an infectious disease known for its red spotty rash, hence a spotted condition.

clue.text: Old magistrate is concerning First Lady

blocks.note: re means about or concerning
in the Bible Eve was the first woman

explanation.surface: An elderly judge is worried about the President's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First Lady' suggests a president's wife, but here it is the first woman of Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was a local official in medieval England with judicial and administrative duties, like a magistrate.

clue.text: Some bees tremble without wings

indicators.note: the wings of a word are its two ends, so both outer letters are clipped off

blocks.note: to shiver is to tremble

explanation.surface: A few bees quiver because they have lost their wings.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the S and R from either end of SHIVER.
explanation.definitionFit: A hive can mean the colony living together in it, a collective body of the insects.

clue.text: Regularly engages clutch

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is taken

blocks.note: the first, third, fifth and seventh letters

explanation.surface: A driver habitually puts the car into gear using the pedal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clutch' looks like the car pedal; it is a set of eggs laid together.
explanation.definitionFit: A clutch is the batch of eggs a bird lays and sits on at one time.

clue.text: Mass of ice mostly happy daughter removed from drink

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is cut
something removed is taken away, so one letter is dropped from the word that follows

blocks.note: glad means happy
D is the abbreviation for daughter
cider is an alcoholic drink made from apples

explanation.surface: Ice cubes nearly cheer up a girl kept away from the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: GLAD loses its last letter, and CIDER loses its D.
explanation.definitionFit: A glacier is a huge slow-moving body of compacted ice formed from snow.

clue.text: Top of mountain collapses from below causing violent weather

indicators.note: the top of a word is its opening letter, so only that letter is kept
in a down answer, reading from below means going upwards, so the order is turned round

blocks.note: the opening letter of mountain
to rot is to decay and collapse

explanation.surface: A mountain summit gives way from underneath in a fierce tempest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top' fits the mountain picture but just takes the first letter; M and ROTS are then read bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm is a spell of rough weather with strong winds and usually rain.

clue.text: Credit note covers removal of fat that sits at the neck

definitions.note: a clause describing a clip-on tie, standing for the adjective

indicators.note: a cover goes round what it hides, so one pair of letters wraps another piece

blocks.note: C is an abbreviation for credit
lipo is short for liposuction, surgery to suck out body fat
N is the abbreviation for note

explanation.surface: A bank credit slip pays for cosmetic fat removal around the throat.
explanation.walkthrough: C and N wrap around LIPO. The answer describes a tie that clips onto the collar rather than being knotted.
explanation.definitionFit: A clip-on tie or bow tie fastens to the shirt collar, so it is worn at the throat.

clue.text: Lawsuit covering rogue's fall

indicators.note: a covering goes over and round something, so one word encloses another

blocks.note: a case is a lawsuit
a cad is a dishonourable man

explanation.surface: A court action is hushing up a scoundrel's downfall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fall' suggests a disgrace; it is a waterfall. The 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a small waterfall, water tumbling down in steps over rocks.

clue.text: Five vote against getting hold of fresh coal that might explode

definitions.note: a descriptive clause standing in for the noun

indicators.note: something fresh is newly made, so the letters are formed anew in another order
getting hold of means grasping, so outer letters clasp an inner piece

blocks.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
the letters taken as written
to vote against is to vote no

explanation.surface: Five people oppose taking on new coal stocks that are a fire risk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vote against' is a single idea here, a no vote, not an instruction to put letters against each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A volcano is a mountain with a vent that can erupt violently with lava and ash.

clue.text: Gruel I cooked is less appealing

indicators.note: cooking transforms ingredients, so the letters are mixed into a new order

blocks.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: The porridge I made is not very tempting.
explanation.walkthrough: Gruel is a thin watery porridge, so the cooking picture is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Uglier means worse looking, so less attractive or pleasing to see.

clue.text: Victorian hiding small crystal

indicators.note: to hide something is to keep it inside, out of sight

blocks.note: prim is a proper, stiffly formal manner thought typical of Victorian times
S is the abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: A person from the 1800s conceals a tiny gem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victorian' reads as a person of that era, but it is an adjective for strait-laced.
explanation.definitionFit: A prism is a block of clear glass or crystal that splits light into colours.

clue.text: Korean city outlawing English style of music

indicators.note: outlawing something bans it, so the letter is banished from the word

blocks.note: Seoul is the capital of South Korea
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: A Korean city bans English-style music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'English style of music' looks like one phrase, but English is the letter removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Soul is a genre of African-American popular music mixing gospel and rhythm and blues.

clue.text: Often overlooked film's dub might be listed here?

definitions.text: Often overlooked film's dub might be listed here?

indicators.note: often overlooked means skipped at frequent intervals, so every other letter is passed over

blocks.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters

explanation.surface: The overdubbed voices of a film, rarely noticed, would be credited on a movie website.
explanation.walkthrough: Skip every other letter of 'films dub'. The answer is the Internet Movie Database, a website listing film credits, and the whole clue describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: The online film database lists cast and crew credits, including dubbing artists most viewers never notice.

clue.text: Balls American women managed

blocks.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled from one end
A is the abbreviation for American
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: American women ran the dances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Balls' suggests dances, but cricket's over is a sequence of six deliveries, so balls gives OVERS.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee a project is to supervise and direct it, the same as managing it.

clue.text: Erection obtained when wife touches everything

indicators.note: things that touch sit right next to each other, so the pieces are joined end to end

blocks.note: W is the abbreviation for wife
all means everything

explanation.surface: A cheeky bedroom picture of a wife being very hands-on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Erection' is meant in its building sense: something put up.
explanation.definitionFit: An erection is any structure built upright, and a wall is one such constructed barrier.

clue.text: Mark, in time, getting pound for crystalline substance

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for mark, the old German currency
taken as written
an era is a period of time
L is the symbol for a pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Mark eventually earns a pound for some crystals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' reads as a man's name, but it is the old German currency. 'In time' looks like 'eventually' and is simply IN then ERA.
explanation.definitionFit: Minerals are naturally occurring solids, most with an ordered crystal structure.

clue.text: Bird with large chest

blocks.note: L is the abbreviation for large
an ark is an old word for a chest or box, as in the Ark of the Covenant

explanation.surface: A big-breasted bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chest' suggests a bird's breast; it is a storage box.
explanation.definitionFit: The lark is a small songbird known for singing as it rises in flight.

clue.text: Help police incursion when leader leaves

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, and its leaving drops it

blocks.note: a raid is a sudden police entry

explanation.surface: Assistance for a police operation after the chief walks out.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first letter of RAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid and help are synonyms, both meaning assistance given to someone in need.

clue.text: Briefly trialled redesigning of letters

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the final letter is removed
redesigning something gives it a new layout, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the word without its last letter

explanation.surface: A new font of letters was tested for a short time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of letters' is the definition, an adjectival phrase like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Literal can mean relating to alphabetic characters, as in a literal error, a misprint.

clue.text: Mallard's rear hunter shot with loud noise

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its tail end, so only the final letter is kept
shot can mean ruined or broken up, so the letters are scattered

blocks.note: the last letter of mallard
the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A duck's backside is hit by a hunter's noisy gunshot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' fits the hunting picture but signals the rearrangement. A mallard is a wild duck.
explanation.definitionFit: Thunder is the booming sound that follows lightning, a loud rumbling crash.

clue.text: Spaniard's agreement to enter boxing arena causes revolt

indicators.note: to enter something is to go inside it

blocks.note: boxers fight in a ring
si is Spanish for yes

explanation.surface: A Spaniard agreeing to fight sparks a rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spaniard's agreement' means the Spanish word for yes, a common crossword trick with foreign languages.
explanation.definitionFit: A rising is an uprising, a popular rebellion against those in power.

clue.text: Rock's more daring for the audience

indicators.note: an audience listens, so the word is taken by its sound

blocks.note: bolder means more daring

explanation.surface: Rock music is getting more adventurous to please its fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' suggests music, but it is a stone. BOLDER and BOULDER sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A boulder is a large rounded stone, a big lump of rock.

clue.text: Perhaps shaves heads of unwilling nude hirsute adults in reality show

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, so each word gives its first

blocks.clueFragment: unwilling nude hirsute adults in reality show
blocks.note: first letters of the seven words

explanation.surface: A TV reality show forces hairy, naked contestants to be shaved against their will.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' says shaving is one way to strip hair; plucking or waxing would do too.
explanation.definitionFit: To unhair is to remove hair, and shaving is one method of doing so.

clue.text: Long-lasting bad rule replaced

indicators.note: replaced means put back differently, so the letters go into new positions

blocks.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A poor regulation that lingered for years was finally swapped out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Replaced' reads as the rule being superseded, but it orders the letters to be placed again.
explanation.definitionFit: Durable means able to withstand wear and endure over time without breaking.

clue.text: Fruit with bulges Penny moved to the front

indicators.note: moving something to the front takes it from the back to the start

blocks.note: lumps are bulges or swellings
P is the abbreviation for penny; it names the letter already at the end of the word, so it adds nothing new

explanation.surface: Penny shifts some knobbly fruit to the front of the stall.
explanation.walkthrough: The P already sits at the end of LUMPS; it just moves to the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Plums are stone fruits with smooth purple or yellow skin.

clue.text: Student tucking into French bread that's unseasoned

indicators.note: to tuck into something is to go inside it

blocks.note: pain is the French word for bread
L stands for learner, a student

explanation.surface: A student eats bland French bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucking into' suggests eating, but it means going inside. L is the learner plate on a British learner driver's car.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain food has no added flavouring, so it is unseasoned and simple.

clue.text: Hard to stop prey flying after unknown wind

indicators.note: flying suggests things scattered through the air, so the letters land in a new order
a stopper plugs the inside of something, so one letter fills a gap within
after places what follows behind the next piece in the answer

blocks.note: in algebra x, y and z stand for unknowns
the letters taken as written
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: It is difficult to halt fleeing prey once the scent is lost.
explanation.walkthrough: H plugs the rearranged PREY, and Z goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A zephyr is a soft gentle breeze, named after the Greek god of the west wind.

clue.text: Dirt from home initially removed

indicators.note: the initial letter is the first, and removing it cuts the start

blocks.note: the hearth stands for the home, as in hearth and home

explanation.surface: Mud is cleaned out of a house first thing.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the H from HEARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth and dirt both mean the soil on the ground.

clue.text: Appetiser covered by lime zest

indicators.note: something covered lies concealed under the surface of the words

blocks.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A starter garnished with grated lime peel.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer straddles the gap between 'lime' and 'zest'.
explanation.definitionFit: Meze are small dishes served before a meal in Greek, Turkish and Middle Eastern cuisine.

clue.text: Coming up, mouths moved through the water

indicators.note: in a down answer, coming up means reading upwards, so the order turns round

blocks.note: maws are mouths, especially of animals

explanation.surface: Fish rising to the surface with gaping jaws as they glide along.
explanation.walkthrough: MAWS read from bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: To swim is to propel yourself through water, and the past tense matches the clue.

clue.text: Cookery firm lamented cooking after master's departure

indicators.note: a departure is a leaving, so that letter is taken out
cooking transforms ingredients, so the letters are mixed up

blocks.note: the letters taken as written
M is the abbreviation for master

explanation.surface: A catering company grieved over its cooking once the head chef quit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cookery firm' looks like a business; it means firm in the kitchen sense. Remove M from LAMENTED, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Al dente is Italian for to the tooth, describing pasta cooked to stay slightly firm.

clue.text: Artist in front of ship displays array of colours

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts
taken as written
the bow is the forward end of a ship

explanation.surface: A painter at a ship's prow shows off a spread of colourful paints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In front of' looks like a position signal, but the 'in' is kept as letters and 'front of ship' is one idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainbow is the arc of spectral colours seen when sunlight passes through raindrops.

clue.text: Rule room number's to be put first

indicators.note: putting something first means placing it at the start, ahead of the other piece

blocks.note: No. is the abbreviation for number
RM is the abbreviation for room

explanation.surface: A regulation says the room number must come before the name.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is'; NO goes ahead of RM.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is a standard or accepted pattern of behaviour, a rule people follow.

clue.text: Spirit of that group cycling

indicators.note: cycling means going round, so the last letter comes round to the start

blocks.note: those refers to a group of things over there

explanation.surface: The team spirit of a bike club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cycling' fits a bike club but means rotating THOSE so its last letter leads.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethos is the characteristic spirit or guiding beliefs of a community or group.

clue.text: Characters in Hamlet lying about tree

indicators.note: characters are letters, and these are found inside the word
about means turned around, so the letters are read backwards

blocks.note: the fourth to sixth letters of the play's title

explanation.surface: Actors in Shakespeare's tragedy sprawl beneath a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' suggests the play's cast but means letters. Hamlet is italicised as a title.
explanation.definitionFit: The elm is a tall deciduous tree, once a common sight in English hedgerows.
